text:
maria: heads up — starting 08:10 UTC we got an alert spike for 502/504s from APAC IPv6-only clients to eu-west edge. Can people confirm?
alex: confirmed. steady increase in 502s on /v1/generate from ipv6 srcs. haproxy backend checks showing Layer4 timeouts.
maria: did a quick dns check: our zone returns both A and AAAA for api.redwood-eu.example.com. we also run DNS64 in the VPC to synth AAAA for legacy A-only backends.
jamie: haproxy logs show backend connections coming from translated 64:ff9b::/96 addresses but healthchecks are IPv4-only probes. example: "Connect from 2a02:xxxx:52345 to 64:ff9b::198.51.100.7:443 (no route back)" and then Server srv-gpu-07 marked DOWN.
tony: sounds like a reverse-path/route mismatch. some gpu subnets (gpu-eu-2) don't have the v6 route pointing to our nat64 appliance, so translated addresses are not reachable from the node.
alex: repro steps I ran: spin ephemeral pod in gpu-eu-2, curl -6 --resolve api.redwood-eu.example.com:443:2001:db8::10 https://api.redwood-eu.example.com/v1/health -> hangs. curl -4 works.
jamie: on the node `ip -6 route show` missing default via nat64 for that subnet. `ip -6 neigh` shows no neighbor for 64:ff9b::198.51.100.7. conntrack entries show INVALID for translated flows.
maria: impact: IPv6-only clients (common in some APAC carriers and mobile networks) either fail or hit high latency retries. Support already seeing tickets.
tony: terraform module `modules/gpu-subnet` in eu-west has the route block for nat64 in gpu-eu-1 but gpu-eu-2 omitted it during a previous cutover. I'll prepare a diff. expect a small egress hop via nat64 -> small cost increase but customer-facing errors need to be fixed.
alex: additional wrinkle: our LB healthchecks originate IPv4 from healthcheck pool; backend only sees translated IPv6 peers for real traffic which trips strict ACLs and makes HAProxy treat server as unhealthy.
jamie: suggested immediate mitigations: (1) add v6 route to nat64 in gpu-eu-2 subnets (preferred), (2) temporarily disable DNS64/AAAA synth for api in eu zone (band-aid), (3) make haproxy healthcheck try both families or accept translated peer.
maria: proposed owners: tony -> terraform route PR; jamie -> lb healthcheck dualstack patch; alex -> kernel/iptables/conntrack tweak so nat64 mappings preserved; maria -> ops notice + status page update.
infra-bot: incident created: INC-2026-621 (P2) assigned eng-infra.
jamie: testing plan: after route add, create ephemeral pod, `tcpdump -n -i any ip6` and watch SYNs to 64:ff9b::/96 then verify `haproxy` backend transitions to UP and healthcheck logs show success.
alex: also add runbook checks: `ip -6 route`, `ip -6 neigh`, `conntrack -L | grep 64:ff9b`, and quick curl -6 repro. I'll add them to infra runbook.
tony: terraform PR incoming, will include a canary apply for one subnet, monitor metrics 30m, then roll.
maria: timeline: aim for route apply plus LB patch tomorrow 14:00 UTC, gradual rollout. If rollback necessary revert route changes and re-enable synth where needed.
jamie: linking related support tickets from APAC mobile carriers — might explain earlier intermittent reports.
alex: note for postmortem: consider making healthchecks explicit dualstack and add CI check to ensure every subnet has nat64 route when DNS64 enabled.
maria: thanks. i'll send a short customer-facing note and coordinate with support. will open postmortem followup once stable.
